llm_raw_reply: Both cards have no joining fee and the same ₹590 annual fee (waived after ₹3.5 L spend). Axis gives 7.5% on Myntra, 5% on Flipkart and Cleartrip plus a 10% Swiggy discount on Wednesdays. SBI also offers 7.5% on Myntra and 5% on Flipkart and Cleartrip, but lists an extra 4% cashback line that isn’t tied to a specific spend. Otherwise the fee structure is identical.
